svg.title: Sliding-window merge, three rounds
svg.desc: Each round ranks one call batch, emits its safe prefix and removes those rows from their original run buffers. A refill row shows precisely which unread rows enter the following round. R2 triggers the first boundary; R4 triggers the second; no unread rows remain in the third.

g.font-family: TeX Gyre Termes, Liberation Serif, serif
